name: Sora no Ue no Omocha
source:
Dormitory stays almost empty at the summer vacations on the island. At one such day main character notices a girl with something resembling a tail showing from her back. Girl quickly disappears, but the next day protagonist discovers that he also has a tail growing!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假期間島上的宿舍幾乎是空的。有一天，主角注意到一名女孩的背上露出了一條類似尾巴的東西。女孩很快就消失了，但第二天主角發現自己也長出了一條尾巴！

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]］
